// This file is a .txt, not a .go, so it is never compiled into the
// internal/config package. It exists solely as a fixture: copy it to a
// *.go file (or lint it directly with golangci-lint's --path override) to
// prove the forbidigo rule in .golangci.yml actually fires on the one leak
// config.Secret's type design cannot prevent — a bare string(...) cast.
//
// See research.md §6 ("Decision: a Secret type — with a documented hole")
// and .golangci.yml's forbidigo pattern:
//   ^string\(.*[sS]ecret.*\)$

package config

import "fmt"

func leakSigningSecret(cfg *Config) {
	// THIS LINE is what the forbidigo rule must flag: casting a
	// config.Secret to string bypasses every redaction hook on the type
	// (String, GoString, MarshalJSON, MarshalText, LogValue) and hands
	// back the raw value.
	leaked := string(cfg.Auth.SigningSecret)
	fmt.Println(leaked)
}
